summary: Anthropic published a Frontier Red Team analysis mapping 832 banned malicious-actor accounts from a one-year period onto the MITRE ATT&CK framework, finding that AI-enabled attackers increasingly use AI for post-compromise activity and agentic orchestration that the framework does not fully capture.

practices.reason: Anthropic describes a concrete risk-scoring methodology and a mapping of observed attacker behavior onto MITRE ATT&CK that a security team could adapt to assess threat actors using AI systems.
practices.quote: We examine 832 accounts that were banned for malicious cyber activity between March 2025 and March 2026 and map them onto MITRE ATT&CK , a longstanding database of the tactics and techniques used by cyberattackers.
